newsitem.title: USA: Electroscope names Karl Hawkins CFO.
newsitem.headline: Electroscope names Karl Hawkins CFO.

text.p: Electroscope Inc said Wednesday it named Karl Hawkins chief financial officer and vice president of finance and administration.
Hawkins most recently was the chief financial officer of Blackfox Technology Group, a contract manufacturing company in Longmont, Colo.
It could not immediately be determined whether the chief financial officer post is newly created or another executive previously filled that job.
An Electroscope spokesman said Vern Kornelsen was the previous chief financial officer -- a post that has been vacant since February.
